<head-word>פְּיָילִי</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>

<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (φιάλη, fiala) 
<italic>a broad, flat bowl</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. I Gen. XL, 12. Targ. Y. I Num. VII, 13 פְּיוֹלִי (Y. II פַּיְילִי; h. text קערה). Targ. Is. LI, 17; 22 פ' כסא (ed. Wil. פַּיְלִי; h. text קבעת כוס); a. fr.—Tanḥ. Naso 1 פְּיָאלִי של חרש an earthen bowl; Sifra M’tsorʿa, Par. 1, ch. 1 פיי' של חרס; Sot. II, 2 (15
<sup>b</sup>; Bab. ed. פְּיָלִי); a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 10, a. fr. פ' פוטירין, v. פּוֹטִירִין.—[Ib. s. 63 קדום פ', קודם פ', read: פִּילִי.]—[Sabb. 90
<sup>b</sup> פיילי ביירי Rashi, v. פַּלְיָא.]—
<italic>Pl.</italic> (ch.) פַּיְילָוָון, פַּיְילְוָותָא, פַּיְילָ', פַּיְלָ' (פִּילָ'). Targ. Am. VI, 6 (ed. Lag. פִּלְוָון). Targ. Y. Num. IV, 7 (ed. Vien. פִּילַיָּו'); a. e.—(Masc. form) פְּיָילֵי, פַּיְילֵי, פְּיָילַיָּא, פְּיָלַ'. Targ. II Chr. IV, 8; 11; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q00655">
<head-word>פַּיִיס</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פִּיס) 
<italic>division</italic>, (cmp. פּוּר, a. בָּצַע) 
<italic>compromise, arbitration</italic>, esp. by counting out a certain number on the raised fingers of those among whom a decision is to be made (v. 
<xref rid="R00054">צָבַע</xref>
<italic>Hif.</italic>), 
<italic>allotment.</italic></definition>
<notes> Yoma II, 2 התקינו … אלא בפ' it was ordained that the cleansing of the altar should not be done (by whosoever was the first to reach it) but according to arbitration by counting &c. Ib. וזה הפ' הראשון and this was the first arbitration (on the Day of Atonement). Ib. 3 הפ' השני מי וכ' the second count was to decide who was to slaughter &c.; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּיָיסוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. 2 ארבע פ' היו שם four times arbitration took place there (on the Day of Atonement). Y. Pes. VI, 33
<sup>b</sup> מפני קילקול פ' because it disturbs the arrangement of the various services allotted severally to the priests; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>; שן דפ', or פ' (sub. שן) 
<italic>ivory</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. I Kings X, 22. Ib. XXII, 39; a. e.—Y. Shebu. III, 34
<sup>d</sup> bot., a. e., v. עֲנִיבָה II. Ber. 55
<sup>b</sup> bot. דלא מחוו ליה … ולא פ' דעייל וכ' man is never shown in a dream a golden palm tree or an elephant passing through a needle’s eye (man dreams only of what he thinks of when awake). B. Mets. 38
<sup>b</sup> דילמא … דמעיילין פ' art thou perhaps of Pumb’ditha where they make an elephant pass through a needle’s eye (are subtle)? Num. R. s. 10; Lev. R. s. 5, v. עַרְסָא; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. פִּילַיָּא,</plural-form> constr. פִּילֵי. Targ. Cant. VI, 8. Targ. Nah. II, 4 (h. text פלדות!).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<notes> Sabb. XII, 4, v. לוּחַ II. Ib. 5 על שני דפי פ' on two boards of a pinax (Rashi: two columns on one tablet). Nidd. 30
<sup>b</sup> the embryo in the womb דומה לפ' שמקופל resembles in position a folded pinax. Gen. R. s. 69 (ref. to Gen. XXVIII, 13) קפלה כפ' ונתנה וכ' he (the Lord) folded it (the land) like a pinax and placed it under his (Jacob’s) head; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>the merchant’s accounts, book.</italic> Ab. III, 16 הפ' פתוח והיד וכ' the book of (God’s) accounts lies open, and the hand writes, and whosoever wishes to borrow may come and borrow &c. Shebu. VII, 1 החנוני על פִּינַקְסוֹ Y. ed. (Mish. 
<pgbrk id="pg1166" />a. Bab. ed. פנ'), v. חֶנְוָונִי. Ib. כתוב בפִינַקְסִי וכ' Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. על פנ') it is written in my book that thou owest me &c. Y. Ned. I, 36
<sup>d</sup> פינקסו נפתחת his account book is open (his sins will be visited); ib. פינקסתו (corr. acc.). Gen. R. s. 81, v. בָּקַר; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פִּינַקְסִין, פִּינַקְסָאוֹת, פִּינַקְסָיוֹת, פִּנַ'</plural-form>. Kel. XXIV, 7, v. אִפּוֹפּוֹדִין. Gen. R. s. 1 דיפתראות ופ' יש לו he (the builder) has before him rolls and tablets (plans and descriptions). Y. R. Hash. I, 57
<sup>a</sup> bot. שלש פ' וכ' there are three books (before the Lord), one for the perfectly righteous &c. (Bab. ib. 16
<sup>b</sup> ספרים); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q00741">
<head-word>פִּיס</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. פָּסַס)

<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵפִיס</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to penetrate</italic>, (cmp. בָּדַק); 
<italic>to cause abdominal trouble</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 107
<sup>a</sup> מִיסְרָן ומֵפִיס this drink is a tempter and then gives pain (Ms. M. ומֵיפֵיס; Ms. O. מייסרן ומיפיס, v. פָּסַס; ed. ומפייס, v. infra).—[מפיס מורסא, v. פָּסַס.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to break a person’s anger</italic> or 
<italic>will, to pacify, persuade, comfort</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shebu. 45
<sup>a</sup> כדי להָפִיס דעתו וכ' in order to satisfy the mind of the employer (to convince him that he was mistaken). Y. ib. VIII, 38
<sup>d</sup> top; Y. Snh. III, 21
<sup>c</sup> bot. מצוה להֲפִיסוֹ it is proper to give him (the owner of the lost animal) satisfaction (by stating the cause of the loss); v. 
<italic>Pi.</italic>—Ab. Zar. 71
<sup>a</sup> צא והָפֵס עלי מנת המלך go and satisfy for me the royal taxes (settle for me as best you can), v. מְנָת.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to arbitrate, decide</italic> (cmp. פָּסַק).</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 33
<sup>a</sup> מי מֵפִיס who will decide (as to the cause of my disease)? Ib. 54
<sup>a</sup> מי מפיס וכ' who will decide which udders are tied up for the purpose of drying them up and which for the purpose of preserving the milk?—Esp. 
<italic>to decide by chance, by drawing lots, counting a certain number</italic> &c. (v. פַּיִיס). Tam. I, 2 מי שטבל יבוא ויָפִיס let those who have bathed, come and take part in the count of chance; הֵפִיסוּ זכה וכ' after they have drawn, he who has won, has won (no appeal is permitted). Yoma 24
<sup>b</sup> למה מְפִיסִין וחוזרין וכ' why did they draw once and again (why not at once for all the functions to be distributed)? Ib. במה מפיסין (Rashi: מפייסין) what garments do they wear when drawing? Gen. R. s. 84 (play on פסים, Gen. XXXVII, 23) שהפיסו עליה וכ' they drew lots about it (the coat) as to who should carry it to his father &c. Sabb. XXIII, 2 (148
<sup>b</sup>) מפיס (אדם) עם וכ' a man may decide by lot (on the Sabbath) the shares of honor at the table &c.; ib. 149
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>פִּיֵּיס</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to pacify, conciliate, persuade</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. l. c. מְיַסְּרָן ומְפַיֵּיס (that drink) chastises us (gives us pain), and yet is so persuasive (tempting). Ber. 28
<sup>b</sup> אני יכול לפַיְּיסוֹ בדברים וכ' I might appease him with words or bribe him with money. B. Bath. 9
<sup>b</sup> כל הנותן … והמְפַיְּיסוֹ בדברים וכ' he who gives a poor man a coin will be blessed with six blessings, but he who speaks kindly to him, will be blessed with eleven blessings. Gen. R. s. 93, end כשם שלא פ' … אלא וכ' as Joseph pacified his brothers only by weeping &c. Y. Snh. l. c. מצוה להפיסו … ואינו מְפַיְּיסוֹ על שקר it is right to satisfy his mind by stating the truth, but one must not do so by a falsehood; Y. Shebu. l. c. מפייסו … אינו מפייסו וכ'. Lev. R. s. 19, end נלך ונְפַיֵּיס לגדלת, v. גַּדֶּלֶת; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 94, end ופייליה, read: ופִיְּיסוּהוּ and they appeased him (Nebuchadnezzar).—Part. pass. מְפוּיָּיס. Ex. R. s. 51 הריני מפ' שמחלת וכ' I am convinced that thou hast forgiven Israel.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְפַּיֵּיס, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְפַּיֵּיס</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be appeased, satisfied, persuaded</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. אותה שעה נֵתְפַּיְּיסוּ … על וכ' now all Israelites were satisfied with regard to the work of the Tabernacle (that everything was correct). Ber. 33
<sup>a</sup> נתפ' אותו השר that prince’s anger was appeased. Pesik. R. s. 10 הרי הגורן בא והכל מִתְפַּיְּיסִים בשביל וכ' when harvesting time comes, all (that now are disputing) will be convinced for whose sake the field has been sown. Yoma 86
<sup>b</sup> ספק מִתְפַּיֵּיס הימנו וכ' it is doubtful whether he will or will not accept his apology; ספק מתפייס בדברים וכ' it is doubtful whether he will be appeased by mere words (without demanding a fine or public satisfaction) &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>donation</italic> (for the purpose of eluding creditors &c.). Y. Keth. II, 26

<sup>a</sup> הרוצה … כותבת שטר פסים לאחרים if a woman desires to withhold her property from her husband’s control, she may write out a deed of trust (a feigned transfer) to a third person (prior to her marriage); Tosef. ib. <sup>b</sup> אם אמר שטר פסים הוא זה (Ms. H. פיס) if he says, it was a feigned sale (you persuaded me to a nominal sale in order to make people believe that you are a man of means).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q00827">
<head-word>פֵּירָא</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<head-word>פֵּרָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> = h. פֶּרִי, 
<italic>fruit, crop</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath 36
<sup>b</sup> פ' רבא the large crop (of grain); פ' זוטא the small crop (of vegetables &c.). Succ. 31
<sup>b</sup> לא גמר פ' the fruit (Ethrog) is not ripe. Ber. 39
<sup>a</sup> פ' עדיף fruit (vegetable) has the preference (over meat, for the purposes of benediction); a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>fruition, usufruct</italic>. Keth. 79
<sup>a</sup> זרדתא … אמרי לה פ' some say the right of felling service-trees or fishing in a pond comes under the category of usufruct, opp. קרנא property (which the heir may sell). Ib.
<sup>b</sup> פ' תקינו … פ' דפ' וכ' the Rabbis allowed the husband the usufruct (the births of the animals belonging to his wife), but not the fruition of the usufruct (e.g. the fine which the thief has to pay for stealing the calf). Ib. עיילא ליה גלימא פ' הוי וכ' if she brought in a cloak, he has the use of it, he may cover himself with it, until it is worn out; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פֵּירֵי, פֵּירִין, פֵּר'</plural-form>. Targ. Gen. I, 11, sq. Targ. Prov. VIII, 19 פִּרְיַי; a. fr.—Shebu. 48
<sup>a</sup> פ' עבידי דמרקבי fruits are liable to rot; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
